description: Turn a spend policy and a role list into approval bands, and show which band no one can actually approve. Choose this when a spend policy has to become a working approval matrix, or when an existing matrix has to be proved to have an approver for every band. Do not choose this to approve a specific invoice, to configure a workflow engine, or to review a user's conflicting duties, which is a separate access check. Example requests: Turn this spend policy into an approval matrix and tell me which bands cannot be approved. | Who can approve a 5000 spend under this policy, and is that band staffed? | Check that every approval level in our policy has an approver with the authority for it.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. Re-sending the same key returns the same job instead of running it twice.

policy.description: The customer's policy.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one rule per line: LEVEL=order:minimum:role, REQUIRED_APPROVERS=number, CURRENCY=code. The approval levels and how many approvers each needs. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

roles.description: The customer's roles.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one rule per line: ROLE=name:holder,holder and LIMIT=role:amount. Who holds each role, and the amount each role may authorise. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment payload (the value the HTTP interface puts in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header), signed for the amount in the payment requirement the first call returned. Required for a priced capability; nothing is charged until the work completes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_approval_matrix_generator

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Approval matrix generator
